# context-window-packer

> Pack messages and documents into an LLM context window by priority, keep pinned items and input order, and truncate safely at word and code fence boundaries Python package `trysac-context-window-packer`, import name `context_window_packer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
